svg.text: 16 Bulk import: preview with an error
Route: /admin/import · Screen: 1280 px wide desktop browser · Access: Admin only (admin site, signed in)
• Two tables (panel feedback: every dish has a bill of materials): Products and Recipes, as two sheets of one Excel file or two CSV texts. An .xlsx is converted by the server, each table
taken from the sheet that holds it, whatever the order; a CSV goes to whichever table its header matches. Both can be edited in the boxes.
• Half a second after any change the server checks every row without saving (a dry run). A dish with a bad recipe row isn't saved at all, rather than with half a recipe; recipe rows of a
dish whose Products row has an error point to it. A raw material marked not in use is a warning, not an error.
• File checks: an old .xls is refused with instructions; an .xlsx over 2 MB is refused. Template download failures show their reason under the links.
